name: EMBL-EBI-Sanger Postdoctoral Fellowship (ESPOD)
amount: EMBL stipend (about GBP 3,536/month after tax, excluding pension and insurance)
other_rules: Projects combining computational (EMBL-EBI) and experimental (Sanger) genomics
self-proposed projects need prior approval from both group leaders
notes: Wellcome Genome Campus, Hinxton. 2026 call ran 27 Jul to 27 Sep 2026; interviews 10 Dec 2026. Apply via EMBL jobs page with cover letter, CV, two references, and (if self-proposed) a project description of up to 1,000 words.
